purpose: single-owner family simulation workspace with school-grounded major confirmation, history reference and compact A4 output
rules: user input never depends on legacy DOM
school candidates require explicit selection before confirmation
major directory candidates are hints until confirmed against the selected school
major confirmation requires school plus major name plus code agreement
history is reference-only and never blocks family整理
stale worker/network responses cannot overwrite newer input
input editing does not re-render the entire volunteer list
legacy simulation runtimes are historical assets and are not loaded by the page
one simulation bootstrap owns page lifecycle
one simulation store owns persisted state
PDF and Android delivery are service/adapter behavior under the same runtime
release revision increments for every code revision
continued revisions must extend modules, not create parallel simulation runtimes
family note is a first-class volunteer field presented inside the existing family decision context
family note supports multi-sentence input and remains in the same persisted unified store
background rank responses must not re-render the volunteer list while users are editing
